description: Community Earth System Model (CESM) is a model or estimator listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Center for Atmospheric Research | Climate and Global Dynamics Laboratory; NSF, National Science Foundation. This expert-level climate model simulates past, present, and future conditions for atmosphere, ocean, land, land-ice, and sea-ice environments. The fully coupled global climate model provides computer simulations. The model gives researchers a wat to conduct fundamental research. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
